ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 75% of the visible ventral surface, bounded by high-contrast low-intensity black pixels along the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white geometric fields occupy the lobes, bifurcated by a dark vertical wedge originating from the peduncle; low-intensity borders exist along all edges, with two distinct small circular black clusters located on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and significant depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys mapped continuously along the trailing edge; amplitude increases at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve beginning at the median notch, transitioning to a concave sweep toward the outer tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of two distinct, isolated circular low-intensity clusters on the inner white field of the right lobe; detection of a large high-contrast reddish-brown cluster on the distal left tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant reddish-brown biological accretion, consistent with barnacle colonization, is present on the distal extremity of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical linear pixel artifacts caused by water droplets shedding from the left lobe extremity.
